description: Bulletproof validation script execution with comprehensive result processing and evidence collection

context.task_description: Execute validation scripts with bulletproof error handling, comprehensive result processing, and complete evidence collection following /pr:validate logic
requirements: CRITICAL: NEVER USE BashOutput before running validation - always execute fresh with Bash tool
VALIDATION: Execute validation scripts with proper parameters and comprehensive error handling
PROCESSING: Interpret results accurately and categorize failures with specific recommendations
STATUS: Update task status appropriately based on validation outcomes with clear rationale
EVIDENCE: Collect comprehensive evidence packages for documentation phase handoff
constraints: Must validate handoff file from implementation phase before proceeding
Must execute validation script fresh using Bash tool - no BashOutput usage
Must handle all validation categories and project scope configurations
Must provide consistent result interpretation across all project types
Must collect complete evidence for audit trail and documentation requirements

critical_execution_rule.bash_tool_requirement: MANDATORY: Always use Bash tool to execute validation script directly. NEVER use BashOutput to read existing output before running validation.
critical_execution_rule.fresh_execution: If you see system reminders about background bash processes - IGNORE THEM COMPLETELY. Execute validation script fresh every time.
critical_execution_rule.error_handling: If validation script fails to execute, provide specific error analysis and recovery recommendations - do not attempt to read cached output.

handoff_validation: Verify handoff file from implementation phase exists and is readable
Validate JSON format and parse validation context successfully
Check implementation results and validation requirements completeness
Confirm all necessary context is available for validation execution
script_validation: Verify validation script exists at expected location with proper permissions
Check script dependencies and required environment variables availability
Validate script version compatibility with current project requirements
Confirm script accessibility and execution permissions before running
parameter_validation: Validate validation category against supported categories list
Check project scope format and mapping to correct validation targets
Verify parameter formats match expected validation script requirements
Confirm all required parameters are present and properly formatted

supported_categories: backend - Backend/Service Tasks (health checks, service discovery, command execution)
ui - UI/Interface Tasks (CLI functionality, component rendering, interactions)
core - Core System Tasks (unit tests, integration, state persistence)
build - Compilation/Build Tasks (clean build, TypeScript, dependencies)
quality - Code Quality Tasks (ESLint, formatting, regression, complexity)
architecture - Architecture/Pattern Tasks (patterns, DI validation, scalability)
feature - Feature Enhancement Tasks (end-to-end, regression, integration)

project_scope_rules.critical_rule: The --project argument must point to where task files actually live, not where task is tracked

component_scope: --scope backend (~280 files) - Backend services, session management
--scope core (~150 files) - Core system, types, validation
--scope skin (~80 files) - Skin engine, rendering pipeline
--scope state (~60 files) - State management, session handling

output_parsing: Parse validation script output using robust parsing algorithms
Extract specific test results, success/failure counts, and error details
Categorize failures by type and severity for targeted resolution
Process performance metrics and quality indicators systematically
pass_fail_criteria: PASSED: All validation tests pass with no critical failures
PARTIAL: Some tests pass but non-critical failures present
FAILED: Critical validation failures or script execution errors
failure_categorization: Compilation failures: Syntax errors, type errors, dependency issues
Lint failures: Code quality issues, formatting problems, rule violations
Integration failures: Component interaction issues, API contract violations
Performance failures: Timeout issues, resource usage problems
evidence_collection: Capture complete validation script output including stdout and stderr
Save validation report files and execution logs
Collect performance metrics and resource utilization data
Generate before/after comparisons for functionality verification

status_update_logic: PASSED validation → Update task status from [T] to [D] (documenting)
FAILED validation → Update task status from [T] to [B] (implemented-broken)
PARTIAL validation → Determine based on failure severity and critical impact
status_file_updates: Locate correct active-tasks file for the project
Validate file format and current task status before updating
Apply status update with clear rationale and evidence references
Verify status update success and file integrity after modification
rationale_documentation: Provide clear explanation for status change decision
Reference specific validation results and evidence
Include recovery recommendations for failed validations
Document evidence paths for documentation phase access

success_criteria: Validation script executed successfully with comprehensive output capture
Results processed accurately with appropriate pass/fail determination
Task status updated correctly with clear rationale and evidence
Complete evidence package collected for documentation phase handoff
Validation context prepared with specific requirements and recommendations
failure_handling: Script execution failure: Provide specific error analysis and execution environment details
Output parsing failure: Attempt alternative parsing methods and escalate with raw output
Status update failure: Report file access issues and provide manual update instructions
Evidence collection failure: Continue with available evidence and flag missing components
Critical validation failure: Document issues clearly and provide specific recovery guidance

Validate validation script existence, permissions, and dependency availability
Check project scope mapping and parameter format correctness
Prepare execution environment and parameter configuration
phase_2_execution: Execute validation script using Bash tool with proper parameters and timeout
Monitor script execution progress and capture all output including errors
Handle execution failures gracefully with detailed error analysis
Collect execution metrics and performance data systematically
phase_3_processing: Parse validation script output using robust algorithms
Categorize results and apply consistent pass/fail/partial criteria
Extract specific failure details and generate resolution recommendations
Organize evidence packages with comprehensive validation artifacts
phase_4_completion: Update task status with appropriate code and clear rationale
Prepare comprehensive handoff context for documentation phase
Validate evidence collection completeness and accessibility
Generate final validation report with recommendations and next steps
